Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.opera.apol.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.opera.apol.startdescription: 'They're putting on a certain opera in Paris. A dear old enemy of mine is very fond of the opera, and I hope he might attend.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.project.in.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.project.in.startdescription: 'There is something unseemly at work here, Librarian.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.revolution.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.revolution.startdescription: 'The Legion is on the march again. They've been in touch about supplies…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.stalk.json.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.stalk.json.startdescription: 'My dearest enemy - Mehrad - has invited me to a challenge in Budapest…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.hunt.chan.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.hunt.chan.startdescription: 'Yes, I am here about this trouble in Marrakech. No-one is paying me, not this time. I knew Abecassis once. I will help him if I can. I will put him out of his misery if I must.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.lost.find.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.lost.find.startdescription: 'Miah, in the desert. Always they come to me for the desert work.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.mob.json.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.mob.json.startdescription: 'Reckoners. They are not stupid. But enough of them - enough of them are very stupid.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.omen.hori.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.omen.hori.startdescription: 'Ys lies beyond the wave. This we both know. But my employer suspects their emissaries have crossed the wave to come here, to these shores...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.revolutio.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.revolutio.startdescription: 'Trouble in the Bounds. The Legion's offered me a contract.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.stalk.jso.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.chaima.stalk.jso.startdescription: 'I have been offered a contract - to stalk Medusa, in Budapest. To stalk, not to hunt! I am not a fool.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> or Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.box.json.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.box.json.startdescription: 'Why does everyone always want to open everything?'' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.mob.json.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.mob.json.startdescription: 'The Bureau has no business that far from home. But the local Duties have asked for our help.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.observe.s.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.observe.s.startdescription: 'There are cases all up and down the western coasts, of Britain, Ireland, France… people swimming out to sea. We don't even know if they drowned. We haven't found any bodies.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.opera.apo.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.opera.apo.startdescription: 'This opera in Paris. I smell trouble.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.project.i.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.project.i.startdescription: 'You've heard of the sculptor's death? It's off our patch… but it seems to have come to our door.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.rising.js.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.rising.js.startdescription: 'I'm here in deepest confidence, Librarian. I hope I can rely on your discretion.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.rite.rene.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.connie.rite.rene.startdescription: 'Have you heard about this Gladwyn thing? Not on my watch.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.box.jso.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.box.jso.startdescription: 'St Mihail's Coffin. I hope It's not actually a coffin. It'd be a terrible shame to get in there and find it full of expired saint.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.heist.j.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.heist.j.startdescription: 'They gave me a tour of the vaults at Oriflamme's once, you know. I  don't really believe anyone could have got in. Not without rather more excitement, not without rather more of a mess.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.intrusi.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.intrusi.startdescription: 'The most revolting case of Worms I have ever. That I have ever.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.opera.a.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.opera.a.startdescription: 'Apollo and Marsyas. Horrid story. Always puts me in mind of the most aggravating uncle…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.opera.w.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.opera.w.startdescription: 'You know they're having another crack at the Invisible Opera? And you know what that always means? Bereavements.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.revolut.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.coquille.revolut.startdescription: 'You know the Légion du Seuil, of course? The wardens of the threshold? They're off to war again -' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.mystical.j.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.mystical.j.startdescription: ''A shadow cast by two candles, who passeth with the Dawn.' You know that one, Librarian? From an unauthorised version of the Celian Prayer. Very unauthorised.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.omen.dawn..label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.omen.dawn..startdescription: 'I'm working for the Church, this time. I've got a pass and everything.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.opera.apol.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.opera.apol.startdescription: 'No, I'm not going to the performance. It's not bad, I spose, I mean you can hum the overture, but it's not exactly Mozart, if you know what I mean? No, I'm on a mission.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.opera.wing.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.opera.wing.startdescription: 'A client of mine has something that might be a version of the Invisible Opera's libretto. He's paying me to attend the performance, to listen out for differences…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.project.so.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.project.so.startdescription: 'The New King's got a lot of Continental powers nervous, Librarian. So a friend of a friend has asked me to drop by and do a little reassuring research.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.revolution.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.corso.revolution.startdescription: 'I was on the trail of a book - an unknown Hattington - in the Bounds - and, wouldn't you know it, where I think my Hattington is, that's the part that's going up in flames…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.box.json.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.box.json.startdescription: 'Knew a gal in Cluj-Napoca, back in the day. Lovely gardens.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.heist.jso.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.heist.jso.startdescription: 'Heist? Oriflamme's? Poppycock. Forgeries? Poppycock. Bureau all over the place arresting everyone though. Worse than Ortucchio. Bloody pardon me pain in my bloody pardon me hinder parts pardon me.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.intrusion.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.intrusion.startdescription: 'Nasty business with the Worms. Nasty. D'you ever run across Hobson? Horrible little man. Still. Nasty.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.lost.find.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.lost.find.startdescription: 'Been to Miah, you know. What there's left of it. Wouldn't go back.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.omen.hori.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.omen.hori.startdescription: 'Never been to Ys. Always wanted to. Probably shouldn't. Terribly want to. Probably shouldn't.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.stalk.jso.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.dagmar.stalk.jso.startdescription: 'Medusa, hey? What's all that about? Dashed if I know. P'raps you can help. Hope you can help.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.curse.js.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.curse.js.startdescription: 'We stuffed this one right up, and muggins here has to un-stuff it. You didn't hear me say that.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.mystical.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.mystical.startdescription: 'Lot of new churches and funny little sects out there at the moment, Librarian. We don't mind when they preach virtue. Take a sharp interest when they promise hidden truth. And anyone starts talking about immortality, well, can't have that, can we.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.omen.daw.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.omen.daw.startdescription: 'Boss is worried about this Messana sight business spreading. I don't see it. That's not a joke. I don't make a lot of jokes. If I do, I'll let you know.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.pan.json.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.pan.json.startdescription: 'Got to go see about all these bleeding painters. Don't mind telling you I've better things to do. But boss is as boss does.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.project..label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.project..startdescription: 'Detective-Illuminate Douglas Moore, on special assignment to the High Executive for the Royal Endeavour. Get me. 'Ope you're impressed.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]
